name: SNOW EAGLE
source:
Mel was ordered to take command of a unit for a special mission in the snowy mountains. 
...It was an obvious "demotion" in the eyes of everyone who saw it. 
She knew how irrational and absurd the reasons for this were. 
There was likely an element of resignation and compromise involved. 
Yet, she accepted the order. 
Because that was the only way of life she had ever known.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130111085616/http://purgatory.deko8.jp/seagle/]official site[/url]]
translation:
梅尔奉命率领一支部队前往雪山执行特殊任务。
……这在所有人眼里都是明显的“降级”。
她知道这其中的理由是多么的不合理和荒唐。
很可能涉及到辞职和妥协的因素。
然而，她还是接受了命令。
因为那是她所知道的唯一生活方式。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130111085616/http://purgatory.deko8.jp/seagle/]官方网站[/url]]
